# Chapter 7 — Cellular Automata

Source: https://natureofcode.com/cellular-automata/

Key concepts: grid of cells, neighborhood rules, Game of Life, elementary CA (Wolfram), continuous CA, emergent patterns from simple local rules.

Seeds:
- Cellular automata chapter shows complex patterns emerging from local neighborhood rules.
- Game of Life and elementary CA demonstrate discrete state evolution on a grid.
- Simple rules produce class IV complexity and emergent structure.
